बॉक्स ऑफिस पर महायुद्ध, प्रभास की शुरुआत दमदार थी पर रणबीर और यश की बाजी मार ले गई!

आदिपुरुष ने पहले दिन रामयाना से २१.७५ करोड़ ज्यादा कमाए थे।
आदिपुरुष की कमाई ८६.७५ करोड़ थी जबकि रामयाना ने ६५ करोड़ से खाता खोला।
लेकिन नितेश तिवारी की फिल्म रामयाना ने १० दिनों में ७०६.३३ करोड़ का आंकड़ा छू लिया है।
आदिपुरुष १० दिनों में २७५.७५ करोड़ पर सिमट गई, यानी ४३०.५८ करोड़ का बड़ा अंतर आ गया।
आदिपुरुष को खराब सी जी आई और निगेटिव माउथ पब्लिसिटी के कारण ८१.५५ प्रतिशत का मंडे क्रैश झेलना पड़ा।
रामयाना की सफलता के पीछे बेहतर विजुअल क्राफ्ट और परिवार का इमोशनल जुड़ाव मुख्य वजह बताई जा रही है।

क्या आपको लगता है कि सिर्फ बड़े स्टार का नाम फिल्म को हिट कराने के लिए काफी है या कहानी और विजुअल्स ज्यादा जरूरी हैं? 🍿🎬🔥

ctx.title: Ramayana Box Office VS Adipurush: Prabhas Opened 23% Higher, But Ranbir Kapoor & Yash Take 430.58 Crore Lead – 3 Things That Turned Tables!
ctx.summary:
Adipurush opened bigger than Ranbir Kapoor and Yash's Ramayana - here's a comparison of both films and what went wrong for Prabhas at the box office! 
 The post  Ramayana Box Office VS Adipurush: Prabhas Opened 23% Higher, But Ranbir Kapoor & Yash Take 430.58 Crore Lead – 3 Things That Turned Tables!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
Few comparisons in Indian cinema history illustrate the power of the audience and their word-of-mouth. One such classic case is the success of Ramayana and the disaster that was Adipurush! Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Ravie Dubey, and Yash’s biggie is adding huge numbers to its tally every single day! Meanwhile, Prabhas, Kriti Sanon, and Saif Ali Khan’s film had a totally different fate!
Om Raut’s Adipurush (2023) and Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana: Part 1 (2026) – both films brought the timeless and epic story of Lord Ram’s sacrifice and Ravana’s ego getting crushed! Both films arrived on the screen as a huge pan-India spectacle, yet their commercial fates are poles apart!
Driven by Prabhas’s unmatched post-Baahubali opening pull, Adipurush actually opened 21.75 crore higher than Ramayana on Day 1. While Prabhas’s film earned 86.75 crore in all languages, Yash and Ranbir Kapoor’s biggie registered only 65 crore India net on the opening day!
In fact, Prabhas’s version of Ramayana stayed ahead on Day 2 as well. However, once audience reactions kicked in, Adipurush suffered a catastrophic 81.55% crash on its first Monday, collapsing from 86.75 crore on Friday to just 16 crore on Monday!
By contrast, Ranbir Kapoor, Yash , and Sai Pallavi’s Ramayana turned a steady Thursday start into an unstoppable streak, exploding to 115.25 crore on Day 5 (Monday) and amassing a colossal 706.33 crore India net in 10 days, towering 430.58 crore above Adipurush’s 10-day total of 275.75 crore !
Mounted on a massive budget, Adipurush suffered immediate backlash over artificial CGI environments, poorly rendered creatures, and awkward character designs. In contrast, Nitesh Tiwari’s Ramayana partnered with Oscar-winning DNEG to deliver immersive, big-screen spectacle that justified premium IMAX and 3D ticket prices.
Diwali is a huge opportunity for a film like Ramayana to score big at the box office! Meanwhile, Adipurush was a non-holiday release during the summer – a period that is usually dull in terms of box office returns!
While Prabhas ‘s sheer stardom guaranteed a historic 221.10 crore opening weekend (Days 1–3), mythological cinema relies heavily on repeat family and senior-citizen audiences on weekdays. Once negative word-of-mouth spread, Adipurush plunged 81.55% on Monday and dipped into single digits by Day 6 ( 7.25 crore ), whereas Ramayana’s emotional sincerity turned families into its biggest strength, driving a 76.15 crore Second Saturday!
Adipurush proved that superstar opening power can buy a historic Day 1 ( 86.75 crore ), but only the audience decides the fate of a film! By respecting the emotional soul of the epic and backing it with world-class visual craft, Nitesh Tiwari, Ranbir Kapoor, and Yash turned a 21.75 crore Day 1 deficit into a 430.58 crore 10-day lead, turning Ramayana into an all-time box office phenomenon!
